title: Large Language Models for Code Generation: A Comprehensive Survey of Challenges, Techniques, Evaluation, and Applications

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance gap (using the Pass@k metric) in code generation when models are prompted with different natural language instructions (e.g., English versus Chinese) and across different programming languages.

Measuring harmful or derogatory code generation associated with specific demographics using metrics such as Code Bias Score (CBS), UnFairness Score (UFS), and the standard deviation of the frequency for all valid demographics.
